The bimodal eutectic alloy (Mg 72 Cu 5Zn 22 ) shows the highest yield and fracture strength (45 5 and 700 MPa) as well as reasonable plasticity (5%).

a change of the fine eutectic (α-Mg + MgZn 2) colony morphology accompanied by the increase of the volume fraction of the coarse eutectic (α-Mg + MgZn 2 + MgCuZn) to cellular morphology play an important role to improve the plasticity of the Mg-Cu-Zn bimodal eutectic alloy

The spherical morphology of the fine eutectic (α-Mg + MgZn 2) colony caused by increasing the volume fraction of the coarse eutectic (α-Mg + MgZn 2 + MgCuZn) can be effective to enhance the room temperature plasticity.
